notes.title: 「A-Train: All Aboard! Tourism - Vistas Abound」now on sale!
notes.content:
※This DLC is only available in Japan※

For one week from today, March 3rd, "A-Train: All Aboard! Tourism - Vistas Abound" will be on sale for 10% off! Please take this opportunity to purchase the game.

[b]Bundle[/b] 

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/30042

[b]DLC only[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2168690/

[h3][u]About "A-Train: All Aboard! Tourism - Vistas Abound"[/u][/h3]

The "A Train" x "Sightseeing" will "expand" even further!
"A-Train: All Aboard! Tourism" has been upgraded to "Vistas Abound" and now you can play through this title with even more possibilities!

As the president of a railroad company, the player extends the tracks, develops the infrastructure, and transports many people. By doing so, the city grows, and the company's revenue increases.

It is up to you to decide how to develop the city as the company grows.
Why don't you create the future of the city with "A-Train"?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41386106/3a1cd8f5b97d5b26a71fca511d33d71e9dbcecf7.jpg[/img]

There are three key points of the "Vistas Abound."

With the addition of actual sightseeing trains, bullet trains, etc. from all over Japan, [b]"Railroad Cars" will expand!!! [/b]

New sightseeing buildings, stalls, signs that represent the bustle of the city, and [b] "Railroad Museum," where you can display your favorite trains, will [b]expand [b]city development[/b]! [/b]

You can share your original train cars or just the topography of your city online, and even process the scenery of your city. You can also [b]share your original train cars, share only the terrain of your city online, and [b]process the scenery of your city with the "Photo Mode" to [b]expand the circle of the A train! [/b]

[u][h3]"Kohma's First Look at a Game in Action"[/h3][/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41386106/1bb02704ed27b8f2220196d6fb4f01f26f9dc6ba.png[/img]

"A-Train: All Aboard! Tourism - Vistas Abound" will be introduced on the YouTube channel of development simulation game player Kohma.
※This stream will also be mirror streamed on Steam.

Date and Time ： Friday, March 3rd, from 9:00 p.m. (JST)
Youtube page ：https://youtube.com/live/gliuGNmsR44
Kohma Twitter ：https://twitter.com/kohma_game

notes.title: A-train PC Classic: Unlock update
notes.content:
Hi fellow town builders!

We're happy to let you know that A-train PC Classic has now be updated with the following changes:

Construction Mode is now unlocked from the start: You do not need to play the 3 tutotials scenario anymore if you wish, but please make sure to understand how the game work to make nice maps for your fellow town makers.

 Free Mode is now easier to find: When you start a new game, you can select free mode from the map selection menu if you would rather play freely and ignore the scenarios objectives.

And a few bugs were squashed too.

notes.title: A-Train PC Classic : English Version is Coming Soon!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27155694/ab72085d975e27a6998e3243a99a024759491725.png[/img]
Hi There,
We are very happy to announce that the English Version of A-Train Classic is coming soon!

A-Train PC Classic is a new game for the PC which takes the franchise to new areas. With the scale and scope of a modern transport and city simulator and the retro aesthetics of the classic games of the past, A-Train Classic offers a new landscape for gamers to create their worlds. Created with a light touch and requiring modest system specification, A-Train Classic is designed to be accessible and flexible.
 
The English version of A-Train PC Classic is due to be released on Steam platform on June 8th. 
 
[h1]Key Game Features   [/h1]
[list]
[*]Become chief executive officer for a leading transportation company to build and develop a transport network to support to support the growth of the surrounding towns and cities.
[*]A deep and rewarding simulation that is made accessible through a step by step tutorial system. Your assistants will help you every step of the way, explaining game concepts and reminding you of your scenario goals.
[*]A living world. Scenarios introduce competitors who will attempt to build their own networks and develop your resources adding a new challenge to the A-Train franchise.
[*]Multiple resources. Ore, Coal, Fish and other natural resources need transportation on your freight network as well as the raw materials your towns and cities need to grow. Concentrate on one or diversify and control them all.
[*]Large number of scenarios. Play to achieve the targets set by the scenario then, if you choose to, continue into open play once these goals have been met.
[*]Multiple methods of transport. Rail, road and tram networks each with their own advantages
[*]Innovation and invention. As the years go by the network and rolling stock will be updated as new inventions such as diesel and electric trains are introduced. These include iconic maglev vehicles.
[*]Underground or overground. If space is an option, the right research unlocks the ability to build networks underground.
[*]Projects. Research your own advancements. Improve the efficiency of your network or develop unique structures and advantages.
[*]Steam Workshop integration. Create your own scenarios and networks then upload them to the Steam Workshop to share with others
[*]Ultra hi res support. A-Train Classic will play on many screen resolutions and includes multiple screen support.
[/list]

We hope you will enjoy this next installment in the A-Train Franchise!

See you on the 9th!

The A-Train Classic Team
